classification.difficultyReason: Recognise vertically opposite central angles formed by three diameters and apply equal-angle chord relationships to three pairs.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.sourceRegion: First row, middle diagram, part q
spec.description: Six perimeter chords and three diameters through centre O. Chord labels are placed inside their corresponding perimeter segments. Ordinary source colours are replaced with black.
spec.mathematics: Clockwise circumference vertices A, B, C, D, E, F are internal construction names only. AD, BE and CF are diameters. AB=y, BC=4 cm, CD=6 cm, DE=5 cm, EF=z and FA=x. Opposite central angles are equal, so opposite perimeter chords are equal.
spec.answerVisibility: Only x, y, z, O and the given lengths 4 cm, 6 cm and 5 cm appear. The printed teacher answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
Vertically opposite angles at $O$ are equal. Equal angles at the centre subtend equal chords.
$$\begin{aligned}x&=6\text{ cm}\\y&=5\text{ cm}\\z&=4\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$
